Howon · Listen & Shadow 03

After the Break-up, and Everything Else
D O   E N G L I S H   W I T H   B R I A N
PART 1 · AFTER THE BREAK-UP
👤 Brian
How were things after the break-up?
헤어진 뒤엔 어땠어요?
break-up — 이별
💬 Howon
I don't have any feelings towards her.
그녀한테는 아무 감정이 없어요.
feelings towards ~ — ~에 대한 감정
같은 패턴으로 — I don't have any feelings towards him anymore. · I have mixed feelings towards that job.
💬 Howon
I felt she had something on me.
그 사람이 저한테 뭔가 마음이 있다고 느꼈어요.
have something on ~ — ~에게 마음이 있다 (구어)
💬 Howon
I forced myself not to be in any one-on-one situation with her while I was in a relationship.
연애 중이어서 그 사람과 단둘이 있는 상황을 일부러 피했어요.
force oneself — 억지로 ~하다 · one-on-one — 단둘이
같은 패턴으로 — I forced myself to get up early. · She forced herself not to check her phone.
💬 Howon
Whenever I met girls after my break-up, I tried not to be seen by the public.
헤어지고 나서 여자를 만날 때마다 사람들 눈에 안 띄려고 했어요.
be seen by the public — 대중에게 노출되다
같은 패턴으로 — Whenever I go out, I try not to be noticed. · Whenever it rains, I try not to drive.
👤 Brian
You're still hung up on her, aren't you?
아직 그 사람한테 미련 있는 거 아니에요?
be hung up on ~ — ~에 미련이 남다
💬 Howon
There wasn't any intention. I just feel sorry for her.
아무 의도도 없었어요. 그 사람한테 미안한 마음뿐이에요.
intention — 의도 · feel sorry for ~ — ~가 안쓰럽다
💬 Howon
I'm a casual drinker, and I was emotionally vulnerable at the time.
저는 술을 가볍게 마시는 편이고, 감정적으로 약해져 있었어요.
casual drinker — 가볍게 마시는 사람 · vulnerable — 취약한
💬 Howon
I was immature back then.
그땐 제가 미성숙했어요.
immature — 미성숙한
같은 패턴으로 — I was impatient back then. · We were all broke back then.
PART 2 · PEOPLE IN THE INDUSTRY
👤 Brian
What are people in the industry like?
업계 사람들은 어때요?
industry — 업계
💬 Howon
Some of them act cocky, show off, and strut around.
어떤 사람들은 잘난 척하고, 뽐내고, 으스대며 걸어요.
act cocky — 잘난 척하다 · show off — 뽐내다 · strut around — 으스대며 걷다
💬 Howon
Some people fish for compliments.
칭찬을 유도하는 사람들이 있어요.
fish for compliments — 칭찬을 유도하다 (엎드려 절받기)
같은 패턴으로 — He's always fishing for compliments. · Stop fishing for praise.
💬 Howon
I can see right through him.
그 사람 속이 다 보여요.
see through ~ — ~의 속을 꿰뚫어 보다
같은 패턴으로 — I can see through that excuse. · She saw through the whole act.
💬 Howon
It's hard to take those people seriously.
그런 사람들은 진지하게 받아들이기 어려워요.
take ~ seriously — ~를 진지하게 받아들이다
같은 패턴으로 — It's hard to take that review seriously. · Nobody took the rumor seriously.
💬 Howon
There are goody-goodies too.
착한 척하는 사람들도 있어요.
goody-goody — 착한 척하는 사람
💬 Howon
When you become a celebrity, you start feeling like Gulliver.
연예인이 되면 자기가 걸리버가 된 것 같은 착각에 빠져요.
celebrity — 유명인 · Gulliver — 거인 (걸리버 여행기)
💬 Howon
In the end, it comes down to common sense.
결국은 상식의 문제예요.
common sense — 상식 · come down to ~ — 결국 ~의 문제다
같은 패턴으로 — It comes down to trust. · In the end, it comes down to how much you practice.
PART 3 · SCRIPTS AND SKILLS
👤 Brian
What makes a good script?
좋은 대본이란 뭐예요?
script — 대본
💬 Howon
A good script has no emotional direction.
좋은 대본에는 감정 지시가 없어요.
emotional direction — 감정 지시 (지문)
💬 Howon
If everything's written in brackets, there's nothing left for the actor.
괄호 안에 다 적혀 있으면 배우가 할 게 없어요.
brackets — 괄호 · nothing left for ~ — ~가 할 몫이 없다
💬 Howon
It just implies, and the actor improvises the rest.
암시만 하고, 나머지는 배우가 즉흥으로 채워요.
imply — 암시하다 · improvise — 즉흥으로 하다
같은 패턴으로 — The director only implies what he wants. · We improvised the whole scene.
💬 Howon
I'm open to feedback.
저는 피드백을 잘 받아들이는 편이에요.
open to ~ — ~에 열려 있는
같은 패턴으로 — I'm open to suggestions. · She's open to moving abroad.
💬 Howon
You need people skills as much as acting skills.
연기력만큼 사람 다루는 기술도 필요해요.
people skills — 대인 관계 기술 · life skills — 생활 기술
같은 패턴으로 — You need social skills as much as talent. · He has the looks, but not the people skills.
💬 Howon
There were so many applicants that I went numb.
지원자들이 너무 많아서 감각이 무뎌졌어요.
applicant — 지원자 · numb — 무감각한
💬 Howon
That question threw me off a bit.
그 질문은 저를 좀 당황시켰어요.
throw ~ off — ~를 당황시키다
같은 패턴으로 — The noise threw me off. · Don't let his comment throw you off.
PART 4 · MY BROTHER
👤 Brian
How's your brother doing?
동생은 좀 어때요?
brother — 형제
💬 Howon
My younger brother had a heart attack.
동생이 심장마비를 일으켰어요.
heart attack — 심장마비
💬 Howon
The 911 team said he wasn't going to make it.
911에서는 동생이 살아나지 못할 거라고 했어요.
make it — 살아남다, 해내다
같은 패턴으로 — The doctors weren't sure he'd make it. · We barely made it to the airport.
💬 Howon
He might have stayed in a vegetative state.
식물인간 상태로 남을 수도 있었어요.
vegetative state — 식물인간 상태
💬 Howon
It was a blood vessel problem, and it runs in the family.
혈관 문제였고, 가족력이 있어요.
blood vessel — 혈관 · run in the family — 가족력이 있다
같은 패턴으로 — Diabetes runs in the family. · Bad eyesight runs in my family.
💬 Howon
They put him under anesthesia in the ER.
응급실에서 마취를 했어요.
anesthesia — 마취 · ER — 응급실
💬 Howon
So a colonoscopy became mandatory for me too.
그래서 저도 대장내시경이 필수가 됐어요.
colonoscopy — 대장내시경 · mandatory — 필수의
💬 Howon
I have exercise-induced asthma.
저는 운동 유발성 천식이 있어요.
exercise-induced — 운동으로 유발되는 · asthma — 천식
PART 5 · RULES AND PEOPLE
👤 Brian
What do you think of people who bend the rules?
편법 쓰는 사람들 어떻게 생각해요?
bend the rules — 편법을 쓰다
💬 Howon
Some people look for loopholes and cut corners.
허점을 찾아서 요령을 부리는 사람들이 있어요.
loophole — 허점 · cut corners — 대충 하다, 요령 부리다
같은 패턴으로 — Don't cut corners on safety. · They found a loophole in the contract.
💬 Howon
They're known for being arrogant.
그 사람들은 거만하기로 유명해요.
be known for ~ — ~로 유명하다 · arrogant — 거만한
같은 패턴으로 — He's known for being late. · The place is known for its noodles.
💬 Howon
I tolerated it as long as I could.
참을 수 있는 데까지 참았어요.
tolerate — 참다
💬 Howon
I tend to defend my friends.
저는 친구를 변호하는 편이에요.
defend — 변호하다, 편들다
같은 패턴으로 — I tend to defend the underdog. · She always defends her brother.
💬 Howon
I did my reserve forces training too.
예비군 훈련도 다녀왔어요.
reserve forces — 예비군
💬 Howon
That actor is recognized and respected.
그 배우는 인정받고 존중받아요.
recognized — 인정받는 · respected — 존중받는
💬 Howon
You can tell from the statistics.
통계를 보면 알 수 있어요.
statistics — 통계 · tell — 알 수 있다
같은 패턴으로 — You can tell from his face. · You can tell from the numbers.
